# GitHub Workflows

## Purpose
This directory is reserved for GitHub Actions workflow files used to automate CI/CD processes.

## Expected Content
This folder may include:
- continuous integration workflows
- continuous deployment workflows
- automated validation steps
- security scanning jobs
- container build and publishing pipelines

## Future Role
The workflows created here will help automate repetitive tasks such as build, test, scan, and deployment operations.

## Status
Prepared for future CI/CD workflow implementation.
